stations.title: Ambrose
stations.say: Run the cleaning step, by name.

stations.title: The counter
stations.text: Each step typed in again, every job.

stations.title: The repair
stations.text: The step's time is on the repair.

captions: Ambrose wants the counter to run the cleaning step by its name.
Today every step is written out again at the counter, for every job.
You keep the steps as values: in variables, given back, and in one table by name.
The counter asks for cleaning by name, and its time lands on the repair.
The workshop's steps live in one table now, and the counter runs them by name.
